da-non-sequitur.evidence: [sidecar review 2026-11-15, issue #8030] C(ϱ) = tr_M = J_K is asserted ("by the Jones–Markov identity"), not derived: nothing connects a diagonal residue of an embedding-dependent integral to a Markov trace. J_K is an isotopy invariant and T_reg − E_cat is embedding-dependent, so the claim needs that difference shown constant on isotopy classes. The surreal reading equates an infinite (ord_ω = +1) quantity with the finite J_K(q).
